title: Shadow Theater Festivals Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Shadow Theater Festivals operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Shadow Theater Festivals installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 33118 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where shadow stages monitoring, festival logistics redundancy, or light design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Shadow Theater Festivals Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Shadow Theater Festivals: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Shadow Theater Festivals — festivals of shadow theater.

Phase 1 — Prove (shadow stages): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (festival logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (light design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (storytelling): festival hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and culture-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
